# Discovery

## Inputs

Approved proposal, source evidence, stakeholder decisions, known constraints, current system context, and unresolved questions.

## Process

Read `AGENTS.md`. Separate facts from assumptions, register provenance, identify actors and end-to-end workflows, test feasibility, record dependencies and risks, and leave unknowns as `TBD`. Do not design or implement a solution during discovery.

## Required output

A discovery artifact linked from the feature manifest containing evidence sources, actors, workflows, constraints, dependencies, risks, assumptions, open questions with owners, and a PASS or FAIL recommendation for the discovery gate.

## Stop conditions

Stop on conflicting authoritative evidence, missing decision authority, inaccessible critical source material, unverifiable assumptions, or pressure to invent facts or start implementation.
